verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents an official MCP server that connects AI tools such as Cursor, VS Code and Claude. It works as a thin bridge that loads GrowthBook Agent Skills and makes authenticated calls to the GrowthBook REST API, and a probe confirmed the dedicated docs page exists. Missing for 10: details of the exposed tools, setup and auth configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents work through it in practice.
